interface.signature: def shortestDistance(N: int, M: int, X: int, Y: int, A: List[List[int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: Matrix dimensions N and M are within bounds, and target coordinates (X, Y) are valid indices.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(N) for j in range(M))
preconditions.description: All cells in matrix A contain only 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: If no path exists from (0, 0) to (X, Y), return -1. Otherwise, return the minimum number of steps (min_steps) required to traverse from (0, 0) to (X, Y) using only adjacent cells (up, down, left, right) with value 1.
The target cell (X, Y) must be traversable (value = 1) for a valid path to exist.
